chapters.title: Chapter 3: Landmark Precedents on Exemption 7(A) and Ongoing Proceedings
chapters.reason: This chapter explicitly teaches core 7(A) precedents—Citizens for Responsibility & Ethics in Washington (CREW), Center for National Security Studies (CNSS), and Silvia Patricia Miranda Juarez—where precise doctrinal language (e.g., 'pending or reasonably anticipated,' standards for agency attestations, 'tip-off' interference, and whole-document withholding) is essential for accurate exposition and classroom analysis.

chapters.title: Chapter 4: Threshold for Exemption 7 — 'Compiled for Law Enforcement Purposes'
chapters.reason: This chapter centers on the Pratt 'rational nexus' test and its application in Campbell, so including those opinions' excerpts is important to present the exact tests, explanatory formulations, and the scope of judicial deference relied upon in subsequent FOIA threshold analyses.
